# Board Game Audio Assistant

> Hands-free 9-language offline voice narrator, local Wi-Fi secret role dealer, Bayesian probability solver, and tabletop toolkit for Avalon, One Night Werewolf, Salem 1692, and party board games on iPhone and iPad.

Board Game Audio Assistant is an offline iPhone and iPad app that acts as an automated voice narrator, local Wi-Fi secret role dealer, and tabletop toolkit for social deduction and party board games — requiring zero internet connection or user account. Nobody sits out as a human moderator: everyone closes their eyes and plays together.

## Key features

- Studio-Grade 9-Language Voice Host: Crystal-clear night-phase voice scripts in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish, and Portuguese for The Resistance: Avalon, One Night Ultimate Werewolf, Salem 1692, Blood and Blade, Dying Message, Cheese Thief, Werewords, and custom party scripts.
- Local Wi-Fi Room (Cross-Language Role Dealing & Voting): Host a peer-to-peer room over local Wi-Fi or personal hotspot so players view secret roles and cast mission votes on their own phones in their preferred language.
- Avalon Bayesian Probability Solver: Track mission teams and vote history to calculate real-time Merlin, Morgana, Percival, and Minion probabilities.
- Siri & Spotlight Shortcuts + Custom Voice Studio: Trigger favourite games hands-free with Siri or the Action Button, and record custom night-phase voice packs saved locally on your device.
- BGG Catalog & 4-in-1 Tabletop Toolbox: Offline quick rules, multi-sided dice roller, random first-player picker, speech countdown timers, and persistent scoreboards.
- Official Support Email: fangdev1063@gmail.com
- Official Website: https://boardgameaudioassistant.netlify.app/
- Optional Lifetime PRO: One-time In-App Purchase removes all ads permanently with Family Sharing and Restore Purchases support.

## FAQ

### Does Board Game Audio Assistant work completely offline without internet or an account?

Yes. All 1,008 studio voice narration files, 15 BGG board game rule references, dice rollers, countdown timers, and scoreboards run 100% offline on your iPhone or iPad with zero account registration. Even multi-phone role dealing and voting run over peer-to-peer local Wi-Fi or personal hotspot without internet.

### Which board games and languages include studio voice narration?

Built-in studio neural voice narration covers The Resistance: Avalon, One Night Ultimate Werewolf, Salem 1692 (Night & Dawn), Blood and Blade, Dying Message, Cheese Thief, and Werewords across 9 languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese.

### How does Local Wi-Fi secret role dealing and anonymous voting work?

One player taps Create Local Room on their iPhone or iPad while friends on the same Wi-Fi or personal hotspot join instantly with a room code. Each player privately views their dealt 3D secret role card in their preferred language and casts encrypted mission votes without passing phones around.

### How many players are supported, and does it run natively on iPad and iPhone Duo?

Hosted tabletop presets support 3 to 12+ players depending on the game ruleset, with automatic balanced role validation. The app is a Universal iOS 18+ and iPadOS 18+ build featuring adaptive Split View layouts on 13-inch iPad and seamless cover-to-inner continuity on iPhone Duo.

### Is Board Game Audio Assistant free, or does it require a recurring subscription?

Core voice hosting, all 9 language voice packs, local Wi-Fi rooms, the Avalon Bayesian probability solver, and the 4-in-1 tabletop toolbox are free to use. An optional one-time Lifetime Ad-Free PRO In-App Purchase removes all ads permanently with Apple Family Sharing and zero subscriptions.

### Can I record custom voice packs or build custom night-phase scripts?

Yes. The built-in Voice Recording Studio lets you record personalized friend or character voice lines on-device using your microphone, and the Custom Script Builder supports creating or importing JSON night-phase flows with automatic text-to-speech fallback.
